title: Mystic Window Vision
description: A woman with braided hair stands at a large arched window, reaching toward a glowing golden egg on the sill as green mystical smoke rises from a bowl. Through the window, a vibrant surreal scene unfolds with purple lavender fields, a river with a red boat and fishermen, warriors on elephants, and a winged angel holding a hammer beneath a lightning-struck sun.
prompt: A woman with intricate braids and colorful robes stands at a large gothic arched window, reaching for a glowing golden egg while green smoke rises from a bowl of liquid. Outside the window is a vivid fantasy landscape with fields of purple lavender, a calm river with a red boat and fishermen, warriors riding elephants, and a powerful winged angel holding a hammer flying beneath a dramatic sun with purple lightning.
